players.bio: Admir Bristrić (born 28 April 2003) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Leicester City.

Alexander David Revell (born 7 July 1983) is an English former footballer who is currently manager of Stevenage. During his playing career he made at least 50 appearances for five different clubs; Cambridge United, Braintree Town, Brighton & Hove Albion, Rotherham United and Stevenage.

Benjamin David "Ben" Broggio is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Stevenage, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. Club career Broggio started his football career at the earliest levels of the Aston Villa Academy, working his way through the ranks before being awarded with his first professional contract on 2 February 2024.

Bobby Armani De Cordova-Reid (né Reid; born 2 February 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or left winger for EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in England, he represents Jamaica at international level.

Carl Liam Piergianni (born 3 May 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Stevenage. In January 2017, Piergianni signed for Australian club South Melbourne in the National Premier Leagues, Australia's second division. In May 2017 after returning to the UK, he signed for Salford City.
Chem Campbell (born 30 December 2002) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Stevenage F.C. He is a former youth international for Wales.

Christian McFarlane is an English-born professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Leicester City. He joined the club on 29 July 2026 on a season-long loan deal from Manchester City. McFarlane was born in Basildon, England and moved to New York City when he was three years old, spending most of his childhood in Queens and Long Island.
Daniel James Barden (born 2 January 2001) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Stevenage. He is a former Wales under-21 international.

Daniel Harry Kemp (born 11 January 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. Club career Early career Kemp joined the academy of Chelsea at the age of six, and spent ten years with the club before his move across London to West Ham United in 2015.

Daniel Shaquille Jabari Phillips (born 18 January 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. Born in England, he plays for the Trinidad and Tobago national team.
Franco Nahuel Ravizzoli (born 9 July 1997) is an Argentinian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Leicester City.
Harry John Howell is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City, on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.

Harry James Souttar (born 22 October 1998) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Leicester City.. Born in Scotland, he plays for the Australia national team. Souttar began his career with Dundee United, making three first team appearances, before joining Stoke in September 2016. He has also played for Ross County on loan.

Jasper Ernest Pattenden (born 15 April 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or full back for EFL League One club Stevenage. Pattenden began his career with Brighton & Hove Albion as a youth player, before moving to Worthing in 2018, where he made his debut in the FA Trophy against Burgess Hill Town. Pattenden joined Wycombe Wanderers in July 2022.

Jordan Alexander Houghton (born 5 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. Houghton joined Chelsea's academy at Under-8 and has been with the club his entire career. In November 2014, he signed his first professional contract.

Jordan Stephen Roberts (born 5 January 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Stevenage. Roberts has previously played for Tamworth, Havant & Waterlooville, Bishop's Stortford, Aldershot Town and Inverness Caledonian Thistle. Roberts was born in Watford, Hertfordshire.

Joshua Brendan David Magennis (born 15 August 1990) is a Northern Irish footballer who most recently played as a striker for EFL League One club Stevenage and the Northern Ireland national team. Having spent the majority of his youth career as a goalkeeper, he switched to striker in 2008 before turning professional in 2009.

Kamari Olivier Newby Doyle is an English professional footballer who plays as a central or attacking midfielder EFL League One club Leicester City, on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.

Lewis Freestone (born 26 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Stevenage. Freestone began his career with Peterborough United and made his league debut on 14 April 2017 in a 2–1 defeat against Fleetwood Town in the Football League One.

Louis Clyde William Thompson (born 19 December 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive-midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. He is a former Wales U21 international. His brother Nathan is a professional footballer who plays with Louis at Stevenage

Luke Jonathan Thomas (born 10 June 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League One club Leicester City. Club career Thomas was born in Syston, Leicestershire and joined the Leicester City Academy in 2008 from local club Riverside FC. He made his professional debut in a 2–0 Premier League win against Sheffield United on 16 July 2020.

Luther Ash James-Wildin (born 3 December 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Stevenage. Born in England, he represents the Antigua and Barbuda national team.
Matthew Gerrard Smith, born 5 October 2000, is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for League One club Stevenage.
Max Woodford is an 18-year-old professional football goalkeeper who plays for the League One club Stevenage F.C.. He holds a unique place in the club's history as Stevenage's youngest-ever player.
Michael Jordan Donald Mellon is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Stevenage.
Olabade "Bade" Aluko is a 19-year-old English-born professional footballer who plays as a defender (primarily right-back) for Leicester City F.C.
Oliver Sanderson (born 30 December 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Stevenage F.C. in EFL League One.

Phoenix Maclaren Patterson (born 1 September 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Stevenage Born in England, he played for Scotland at youth international level.
Samuel Charles Braybrooke is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Leicester City. He has previously played on loan for Dundee and Newport County.

Saxon Owen Earley (born 11 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back and midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. Earley joined Norwich City at under-9 level, and turned professional in 2021, before signing a one-year extension in February 2022. He moved on loan to Stevenage in July 2022. He signed for Plymouth Argyle in January 2023 for an undisclosed fee

Terence Owen Vancooten (born 29 December 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Stevenage. Born in England, he represents the Guyana national team. Following youth spells at four clubs, Vancooten joined Staines Town in 2014 and established himself in the first team during the 2015–16 season.

Terence Charles Taylor (born 29 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Stevenage. Born in Scotland, he represented Wales at under-21 international level.
Thomas Watson (born 8 April 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Leicester City, on loan from Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.

Tommy Hogan Setford is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One side Stevenage, on loan from Premier League club Arsenal. Born in the Netherlands, he represents England at youth international level.

Emir Tuğra Turhan is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for League One club Stevenage, on loan from the under-19 team of Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir. Born in Switzerland, he has opted to play for Turkey internationally.

Wanya Marçal-Madivadua is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for EFL League One club Stevenage. Born in England, he has represented Portugal at youth international level.
Will Alves (William Thomas Alves) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Leicester City F.C.

Woyo Coulibaly is a professional footballer who plays as a full back for EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in France, he plays for the Mali national team. On 19 June 2019, Coulibaly signed his first professional contract with Le Havre AC. Coulibaly made his professional debut for Le Havre in a 1-1 Ligue 1 tie with Chamois Niortais on 2 August 2019. On 30 August 2021, he joined Parma.
